verdict.rationale: Asana publishes an official OpenAPI specification in its GitHub repo Asana/openapi. The repo covers the REST API (defs/asana_oas.yaml) and app components (defs/app_components_oas.yaml), so an AI-native user can download a machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s at common developer-site paths do not contradict this, because the spec is hosted on GitHub instead. Missing for 10: a spec served at a standard discoverable URL on developers.asana.com (e.g. /openapi.json), and hands-on or independent confirmation that the published YAML is complete and current.
